title: नेपालमा स्थानीय पाठ्यक्रमको अवधारणा, अवस्था र गणितीय विषय क्षेत्रको स्थान: एक  सिंहावलोकन
nepali: नेपालमा स्थानीय पाठ्यक्रम समुदायको स्थानीय आवश्यकता, रुचि र सांस्कृतिक अभ्यासहरूमा आधारित भएर बनाइएको पाइन्छ । स्थानीय पाठ्यक्रम विकास विद्यालयका प्रधानाध्यापक, शिक्षक र समुदायका सदस्यहरू सम्मिलित एक सहयोगी प्रक्रिया हो । यस लेखमा स्थानीय पाठ्यक्रम विकास गर्ने प्रक्रिया, यसको विकासलाई प्रभाव पार्ने कारकहरू, सामना गर्नुपर्ने चुनौतीहरू, गणित विषय क्षेत्रको स्थान, स्थानीय पाठ्यक्रममा प्रयोग गरिने विधिहरू स्थानीय पाठ्यक्रमा गणित र स्थानीय पाठ्यक्रम अभ्यासको विष्लेशण गर्ने उद्देश्य राखिएको छ । नेपालमा स्थानीय पाठ्यक्रम विकास र कार्यान्वयन प्रक्रिया सामुदायिक आवश्यकताहरू, सरकारी नीतिहरू र उपलब्ध स्रोत साधनहरू जस्ता विभिन्न कारकहरूबाट प्रभावित छ। त्यसैगरी यसमा पाठ्यक्रम विकास प्रक्रियामा भएका विविध चुनौतीहरू र स्थानीय पाठ्यक्रमले शैक्षिक क्षेत्रमा समेट्ने महत्वपूर्ण पक्षहरूलाई समेत समावेश गर्ने प्रयत्न गरिएको छ ।
american_english: In Nepal, the local curriculum is found to be based on the local needs, interests and cultural practices of the community. Local curriculum development is a collaborative process involving the school principal, teachers and members of the community. This article aims to analyze the process of developing the local curriculum, the factors affecting its development, the challenges to be faced, the place of the mathematics subject area, the methods used in the local curriculum, mathematics in the local curriculum and the analysis of local curriculum practice. In Nepal, the process of development and implementation of the local curriculum is influenced by various factors such as community needs, government policies and available resources. Similarly, an effort has been made in this to include the various challenges in the curriculum development process and the important aspects that the local curriculum covers in the educational field.

Developing the local curriculum is a team effort involving the school principal, teachers and community members. This paper tries to look at how the local curriculum gets developed, what factors affect its development, the challenges one has to face, where mathematics fits in, the methods used in the local curriculum, mathematics in the local curriculum and an analysis of local curriculum practice. In Nepal, the development and rollout of the local curriculum is shaped by various factors like community needs, government policies and the resources available.
